headline: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
title: Blue-Eyes White Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Seto Kaiba's signature monster. What is it? A Level eight LIGHT Dragon-type Normal Monster with three thousand attack and two thousand five hundred defense. What does it do? It has no effect. It just hits hard, and three thousand attack beats most monsters in a straight fight. How do you use it? A Level eight monster needs two Tributes to Normal Summon, so players use support cards. The White Stone of Legend adds a Blue-Eyes from your Deck to your hand when it is sent to the Graveyard. And Trade-In lets you discard a Level eight monster like Blue-Eyes to draw two cards. Fun fact: it is card number one, L O B E N zero zero one, in the first English set. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
